# v0.8.5 validation record

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

This record covers the isolated `moddotplot-interactive-0.8.5-source` copy. The sibling
v0.8.4 source was retained for manual comparison and rollback. No deployment, upload,
tag, or remote publication was performed.

## Browser checks

The complete Playwright application suite ran against the production build in
Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Cross-browser application suite | Passed serially: 71 tests; 4 intentional non-Chromium export-payload skips |
| Exact controls | Identity/footprints default, Bases legend, anchor recomputation, and direction shortcut passed in all three engines |
| Initial exact-state consistency | Geometry controls remain disabled until the worker comparison is ready; delayed-worker regression passed in all three engines |
| Exact pixel regression | Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit passed at DPR 1 and 2, at both 720 px and non-divisible 701 px canvas sizes, with no interpolated colors |
| Responsive behavior | Existing Clear-button separation, plot-window-size, grid, export, recovery, and interaction checks remained passing |
| Network/privacy check | The exact 72 bp fixture produced no unexpected non-loopback requests |

The five-worker browser run recorded one Firefox refinement timeout after 70 passes and
four expected skips; that test passed immediately in isolation, and the complete suite
then passed with one worker. This was treated as shared-machine timing contention rather
than a product failure.

A separate manual visual reproduction used the exact reported FASTA at DPR 1. The
automated pixel regression repeated it at DPR 1 and 2 in every browser engine. Together
they confirmed:

* v0.8.4 and v0.8.5 Full footprints contained identical 72 by 72 numeric matrices;
* default v0.8.5 displayed Identity, Full footprints, the one-base/k-mer banner, and
  separate mismatch and no-evidence keys;
* Bases retained the four A/C/G/T colors and added its categorical legend;
* Anchors produced the expected 1,352 matching-start cells and reported its distinct
  configuration digest;
* Full footprints and anchors retained stable categorical SHA-256 digests across both
  device scales and both canvas sizes;
* screenshots contained only the expected identity or A/C/G/T colors, with no blended
  intermediate pixels;
* hover text separately reported `identity 100.00%`, `identity 0.00%`, and
  `no k-mer evidence`; and
* switching to direction updated both the banner and visible provenance.
